name: knobe-verify-vscode
description: Read-only, offline verification of .knobe.md files on open and save. Built on KNOBE; verdicts come from the vendored knobe-core.js engine.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Verification is read-only and runs no workspace code. In an untrusted workspace, the size-limit and timeout settings come only from your user settings, not the workspace.

knobeVerify.autoVerify.description: Verify *.knobe.md files automatically when they are opened or saved. When off, use the Verify KNOBE command.

knobeVerify.autoVerifyMaxSizeKB.description: Files larger than this (in KB) are not verified automatically. The status bar offers a click-to-verify instead, and the Verify KNOBE command always runs. Capped at 262144 (256 MB).

knobeVerify.timeoutSeconds.description: Stop a verification that has not finished after this many seconds. It runs in a worker thread, so the editor stays responsive either way.

enumDescriptions: Show a notification when the active file's result is failed or unreadable, or verification could not run.
Also notify for verified-body-modified and for warnings or invalid conformance.
Never notify; the status bar still shows every result.
knobeVerify.announceProblems.description: Announce verdicts that need attention with a notification, so they reach screen reader users and anyone not watching the status bar. Each distinct result is announced once.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:offline: npm run compile && unshare -rn node test/integration/run.mjs
